name: Accidental Hypnosis
source:
What happens when a simple trick goes too far?

You reunite with Rinka—your childhood friend, once just a teasing memory. But when an old coin unlocks something deep inside her, what starts as a playful experiment quickly spirals into something far more intense… and far more explicit.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561260/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当一个简单的技巧走得太远时会发生什么？

你与林卡重聚——你儿时的朋友，曾经只是一个戏谑的记忆。但当一枚旧硬币解开了她内心深处的某些东西时，一开始只是一个有趣的实验，很快就演变成更加激烈……也更加明确的事情。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561260/]Steam[/url]]
